acceptanceCommands: DEMO_E2E_ARTIFACT_DIR=<built artifact> pnpm --filter @juli/demo exec playwright test e2e/exit-gate/landing-doors.spec.ts
doNotInfer: Do NOT add the values to a runtime EnvironmentFile or the systemd unit — Next inlines NEXT_PUBLIC_* at BUILD time, so runtime env changes nothing. Verified: the deployed demo unit has no EnvironmentFiles and the built chunks contain zero occurrences of 'supabase'.
Do NOT delete the unconfigured branch of demo-landing.tsx as dead code — it is a real state and must keep its test.

Do NOT string-replace into any existing `needs:` block in release.yml. CI workflow edits are APPENDS; duplicate `- <job>` entries make a replace hit the wrong job and an empty needs.X.result is the silent symptom.
Do NOT commit either secret value. The workflow references secrets; demo.env.example carries names only.
Do NOT assert the door from jsdom alone — that is exactly how #1319 passed while shipping a dead door. The artifact-mode Playwright assertion is the criterion that matters.
Do NOT weaken buildGoogleAuthorizeUrl's null return; the honest-disabled contract stays.
